ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Covering the Disadvantaged - Students will develop stories examining the effects of economic disparity on citizens of Champaign County. The project is funded by the Marajen Stevick Foundation, a News-Gazette community foundation; the John S. and James L. Knight Foundation; and the University of Illinois. Previously listed as Covering Poverty.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to News-Editorial or Broadcast Journalism major(s). Not intended for Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
